use: Current research hypothesis sources only, never historical data, verified leader identity or training labels
scope: Two GitHub original repository/code sources and two forum original posts, bounded requests once each, bodies and comments separated

sources.type: original repository with code raw captured
sources.adopt: Stock genetics, price/volume and stage-specific next-board distinction are hypotheses.
sources.reject: Handwritten fixed sector premiums, historical requests supplemented with current valuation/flow, hardcoded success claims and same-buy-day stops are not imported.

sources.adopt: Separate descriptive theme/ladder score from demonstrated next-day prediction; do not assume hand weights predict.
sources.reject: No performance, weights or external labels copied.

sources.author: 初寻888
sources.adopt: Anchor break vs collapse and contemporaneous low-board competition may distinguish cycle nodes.
sources.reject: Individual hindsight chains, guaranteed parent-causation, one-generation-lower universal law and winner-only exclusions do not become labels.

sources.type: original author body; author comments not merged
sources.author: 板客流云
sources.displayed_comment_time: 2026-09-01 06:08 Asia/Shanghai is comment time, not inherited by body
sources.adopt: Stock prior limit-up tendency, consolidation, liquidity and market-cycle interaction are testable.
sources.reject: Specific topic membership, unverified event claims, authorship popularity, fixed capital/turnover rules and intraday evidence unavailable historically are not imported.

historical_time_policy: Sources actually obtained now and not backdated. Features recomputed only from signal-date/prior archived prices; historical study is not pristine blind.
second_stage_policy: The same first-board selected stock is re-evaluated at second-board close with that close data only; no second-board outcome leaks into first-board call.
